MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(split(o.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - 0 +
      (2026 - CAST(split(o.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64)) -
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(split(o.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split(o.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split(o.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 15) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
  END AS age
WITH DISTINCT o, age, t
WHERE age = 65 OR (t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans')
RETURN o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
